pages.text: There are 5 different presses used in the $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l).

pages.title: Processor Presses
pages.text: The Silicon, Logic, Calculation, and Engineering presses are used in the production of $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)processors$(/l). These 4 presses are obtained by breaking a $(l:items_blocks_machines/mysterious_cube)Mysterious Cube$(/l) in a $(l:ae2_mechanics/meteorites)meteorite$(/l). They can also be duplicated in an $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l).

pages.title: Name Press
pages.text: The Name Press can be used in an inscriber to name items, similar to an anvil.$(br2)To craft, right click the $(l:items_blocks_machines/cutting_knives)Certus Quartz Cutting Knife$(/l) or $(l:items_blocks_machines/cutting_knives)Nether Quartz Cutting Knife$(/l) and insert an ingot of metal, you will then have to type the name you wish to write onto the plate then simply extract the finished plate. You can use one or two plates at a time in the inscriber, if you use two plates, it will print the name
using the combination of both names, top slot, then bottom slot.
